config.moduleName: CLAW - Configurable Lycanthrope Anatomy and Weight

installStep.name: Required bodies and human morph linkage

plugin.name: Required: HIMBO male + CBBE female bodies and human morph linkage
plugin.description: HIMBO male and CBBE female bodies are mandatory separate dependencies. If you use 3BA, install CBBE as its required female base too. Declare CBBE or CBBE+3BA on the next page. This installer supplies conversion profiles, not human bodies. Vanilla human bodies are not supported by this release. Human morph linkage is required and cannot be unchecked. One CommonLib DLL serves the declared SE, AE and VR candidate versions. Game mechanism tests passed on SE 1.7.104.0 / SKSE 2.3.1 with official RaceMenu and HIMBO/3BA; other runtimes and CBBE have offline coverage only. Install matching SKSE, RaceMenu/SKEE and Address Library separately. The module requires active RaceMenu.esp, HIMBO.esp and CBBE.esp markers; no ESP name or shared mesh path proves a complete human-body installation. Read the included runtime contract for exact load boundaries.

plugin.name: HIMBO 5.8 male + CBBE 2.0.3 female (required)
plugin.description: Declare the human bodies actually installed. HIMBO and the CBBE female base are required in both choices; 3BA is an extension that also requires CBBE. Install all author-declared dependencies separately. This choice adds only CLAW conversion profiles and does not install bodies, presets or physics. Active 3BBB.esp recommends 3BA; otherwise CBBE is recommended. You may choose CBBE even when the 3BA marker is active if your winning body meshes require it. These markers do not prove the effective meshes or DLL compatibility. Reinstall CLAW when changing body families. Vanilla is not supported.

plugin.name: Originally-beast OBody source integration
plugin.description: Installs the CLAW source host for eligible actors first encountered as wolves. Requires active OBody.esp and its complete dependency chain. OBody supplies ordinary human source values; CLAW converts them to wolf morphs. Skip to omit this host.
